environment.description: Celery worker running in Docker container on ECS Fargate with identical application code. PyJWT version 2.8.0 installed via pinned requirements. The container image is built with a multi-stage Dockerfile where the final stage copies only the wheel artifacts from a builder stage that runs pip-compile with hash verification. The pgBouncer instance runs with server_tls_sslmode=verify-full and client_tls_sslmode=require. The ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/WorkerBoundary) that restricts secrets access. Redis broker requires TLS mutual auth with client certificates rotated via ACM PCA. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and /etc/app/keys is mounted from an EFS access point with uid/gid enforcement.

config.redis_mtls: ACM PCA issued client certs, broker requires TLS 1.3
config.filesystem: read-only rootfs, EFS access point for key mount
config.container_security: seccomp default profile, no-new-privileges, drop ALL capabilities
